stem.text: The sound from a loudspeaker placed above a tube causes resonance of the air in the tube.
A stationary wave is formed with two nodes and two antinodes, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a tall rectangular tube with a loudspeaker above it. Inside the tube is a stationary wave drawn as a pattern of two loops. A vertical double-headed arrow on the left, between dashed lines at the top and bottom of the tube, is labelled 60 cm. The loudspeaker is labelled loudspeaker.

stem.text: The speed of sound in the air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the frequency of the sound?
